metadata.title: feat(oauth): add extra_auth_params support for OAuth authorization URL
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description: ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes #4115 --- ## 📝 Summary Add `extra_auth_params` support for OAuth gateway configuration, allowing administrators to pass provider-specific query parameters to the OAuth authorization URL. **Problem:** OAuth providers like Google require `access_type=offline` to issue refresh tokens, Auth0 requires `audience` for JWT access tokens, and Microsoft needs `domain_hint` — but Context Forge had no way to pass these parameters. **Solution:** New `extra_auth_params` field (Dict[str, str]) in gateway OAuth config, with dynamic key-value UI in Admin and proper URL merging in both PKCE and non-PKCE paths. Also fixes a pre-existing bug where the PKCE URL builder would produce invalid URLs if `authorization_url` already contained query parameters (`?` duplication). --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [x] Bug fix - [x] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | pass | | Unit tests | `make test` | pass | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | | I also tested with local docker-compose environment manually. --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) **Files changed (7):** - `oauth_manager.py` — PKCE + non-PKCE path extra params merge + URL builder bug fix - `admin.py` — form parsing for extra_auth_params - `admin.html` — dynamic key-value UI (Add Parameter button, matching Custom Headers pattern) - `gateways.js` + `admin.js` — JS functions for dynamic rows - `schemas.py` — field description updates - `test_oauth_manager_pkce.py` — 10 new tests (happy path, security/override protection, edge cases, bug fix) **Test coverage:** - Extra params appear in authorization URL (PKCE + non-PKCE) - Core OAuth params (client_id, response_type, state) cannot be overridden - Empty dict / None / non-dict safely ignored - Base URL with existing query params produces valid URL (`?` count == 1)

commits.message:
feat(oauth): add extra_auth_params support for OAuth authorization URL

Allow gateway administrators to pass provider-specific parameters
(e.g., access_type, prompt, audience, domain_hint) to the OAuth
authorization URL via a new extra_auth_params field in gateway config.

Changes:
- oauth_manager.py: merge extra_auth_params in both PKCE and non-PKCE
  authorization URL paths; fix PKCE URL builder to handle base URLs
  with existing query parameters (urlparse/parse_qs)
- admin.py: parse extra_auth_params JSON from gateway add/edit forms
- admin.html: dynamic key-value UI for extra auth params (matching
  existing Custom Headers pattern)
- gateways.js + admin.js: addExtraAuthParam/updateExtraAuthParamsJSON/
  loadExtraAuthParams functions
- schemas.py: document extra_auth_params in oauth_config field descriptions
- tests: 10 new unit tests covering PKCE/non-PKCE paths, core param
  override protection, empty/None/non-dict handling, URL bug fix

Signed-off-by: kimsehwan96 <sktpghks138@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(oauth): harden extra_auth_params and fix CI lint issues

- Filter core OAuth params (client_id, redirect_uri, state, response_type,
  scope) from extra_auth_params in non-PKCE authorization URL path to
  prevent parameter injection
- Remove redundant import json in admin.py form parsing (already at top level)
- Remove redundant urlparse reimport in oauth_manager.py (already at top level)
- Apply black formatting to schemas.py description fields
- Update .secrets.baseline line numbers
- Add unit tests for admin form extra_auth_params parsing (valid + invalid JSON)
- Add security test for non-PKCE core param override prevention

Signed-off-by: kimsehwan96 <sktpghks138@gmail.com>
